entry.description: `%aspnet-request` no longer reads the request body from the client. It used to load the form under the appender lock, so a client withholding its body held every thread logging to the appender. Form fields now appear only once the application has read the body in classic or buffered mode, and a bufferless read no longer turns the whole conversion into `NOT AVAILABLE`. Lookups such as `+%aspnet-request{REMOTE_ADDR}+` are unchanged (ANT-2026-SWV3M1YH, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
